verdict.rationale: monday.com's agent marketing says agents can automate status updates and performance reports on a schedule, and can surface risks and progress gaps, so the core idea of AI-generated status updates is a first-party claim. It is a single thin marketing line, though, with no detail on how drafts are built from recent board activity. missing for 10: documentation of AI drafting a status update from recent project/initiative activity, details of the drafting workflow and editable output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity

citations.quote: Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
